subject: 大足宝顶山第8号龛千手观音主尊
caption: 大足石刻 · 宝顶山千手观音
南宋 · 主尊与放射手臂局部
author: Yumeto
source_note: 采用2025年修复后近正面实拍。图版明确为主尊及邻近放射状手臂的疏朗线描局部，不是第8号龛全景或完整手数复原。目視检查中央合十、胸侧掌、膝上掌、膝前掌四组主手的位置，并保留上举臂与持物手的层次；不补造龛壁或完整莲座。
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a single fine-line heritage sculpture illustration for the Chinese heritage collection 访古.
Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER, an existing Vairocana Buddha contour drawing. Match its elegant, delicate, slightly organic thin lines, restrained detail, generous blank areas, and consistent visual density. Image 2 (and subsequent photos if applicable) is SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY: draw the actual named monument in that reference, preserving its identifying silhouette, roof type, visible storey count, bay count, openings, and proportions.
Create a refined, sparse BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE line drawing. Use confident fine contours with a few finer internal structural lines. All surfaces remain WHITE; use outlines for doors and windows rather than dark fills. No solid shadows, no broad grey shading, no crosshatching, no pencil grain, no texture, no gradient. No color, no gold, no black background. The white will become transparent and the ink the relevant dynasty color in the website.
Show the complete monument, centered, approximately straight-on at facade level, with verticals vertical and minimal perspective. Use only a few short ground lines. Remove tourists, foliage, vehicles, wires, modern signage, fences obstructing the structure, neighboring distractions and sky. Preserve architectural ornament selectively, without filling every roof tile or brick. No invented features. No labels, letters, calligraphy, dimension lines, captions, watermark, frame or border.
Subject: the actual THOUSAND-ARMED GUANYIN 千手观音 of BAODINGSHAN 宝顶山, Dafowan niche 8, Dazu rock carvings, Chongqing, Southern Song. Image 2 is a clear actual frontal photograph after conservation. Create a selective contour STUDY OF THE CENTRAL GUANYIN AND ITS IMMEDIATE RADIATING HANDS, NOT an invented view of the complete grotto. Preserve the actual central front-facing serene face, tall richly tiered crown with miniature Buddha motifs indicated selectively, long ribbons descending at both shoulders, jeweled chest and symmetrically seated draped body. Precisely preserve the FOUR visible principal front pairs of hands: one pair joined in prayer at chest center, one pair held palm-up out to the sides near chest height, one pair cupped together at lap center, and one pair resting down on the two knees. Trace their actual positions from Image 2. Additional larger arms extend upward and outward behind the shoulders, including paired hands above crown; behind those are many small radiating palms with fine fingers and selected held implements, organized as the photograph shows. Retain representative clear outlines of the nearby radiating arms and hands while leaving generous white gaps; never merge hands into a dark mass, never create a thick solid halo. Main figure outline is the focus, smaller surrounding hands become progressively finer and sparer toward the image edges. Do not try to depict an exact count of the entire sculpture's hundreds of hands. This is an explicitly selected DETAIL PLATE: follow only geometry visible in the photo, don't invent a closed oval mandala border or full circular halo beyond its visible edges, and don't fabricate lower body anatomy below the draped knees. Exclude the flanking standing attendants, base demons, cave wall, altar, railings and red cloths. Show the central figure from its crown to the draped knee/seat edge with two or three robe fold contours, no new lotus pedestal. Thin flowing BLACK outlines on pure WHITE, no gold, shadows, hatching, shading, solid dark regions, inscriptions or labels. Master Image 1 supplies the same calm delicate line weight and blank face/garment treatment. Landscape 1536×1024, central principal figure near 70% height, surrounding open radiating hand cluster occupies about 85% width with clean white margin. The principal figure's crown, all main hands and draped knees must be fully visible; fine outer partial hand rays terminate naturally as an incomplete contour sketch rather than a rectangular crop.

historical_sources.title: 大足石刻
historical_sources.evidence: 宝顶山第8号龛千手观音，南宋淳熙至淳祐年间（1174—1252），观音结跏趺坐、身侧及上方放射状手臂。

historical_sources.title: 宝顶山石窟造像介绍
historical_sources.publisher: 重庆市大足区人民政府
historical_sources.evidence: 赵智凤主持宝顶山石窟开凿；第8号龛造像占据崖面88平方米。

historical_sources.title: 照片坐标元数据
historical_sources.evidence: Yumeto照片拍摄点29.754820,105.793991，位于千手观音前；用作所选龛附近地图定位，不声称测绘中心点。

site_recommendation.name: 大足石刻

site_recommendation.yearNote: 史料范围1174—1252；1200只作约略排序，不是确切开凿年。
site_recommendation.location: 重庆市大足区宝顶山大佛湾第8号龛
site_recommendation.latlon_note: 该龛前摄影点，作为附近定位
site_recommendation.lede: 宝顶山的岩壁上，观音的手臂向四周展开。主尊低眉合十，密集手势与法器让南宋匠人的构思凝成一龛。

facts.label: 所绘局部
facts.text: 宝顶山大佛湾第8号龛千手观音主尊及邻近手臂；不是整龛全景。

facts.label: 南宋营造
facts.text: 造像开凿于淳熙至淳祐年间，属于赵智凤主持营建的宝顶山石窟。

facts.label: 放射构图
facts.text: 全龛占据约88平方米崖面，手臂向两侧和上方展开，手中各执器物。
